summary: Corrective MaterialDNA finding: the proposed percent-sign semantic-key defect is not present. validateProjectKey uses the Lua/Luau pattern ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/%-]*$. In Lua-pattern syntax, '%' escapes the following non-alphanumeric character, so the trailing '%-' denotes a literal hyphen inside the character set; it does not add '%' to the accepted alphabet. A literal percent would require its own escaped-percent pattern token. Therefore the implementation already matches its [a-z0-9._/-] diagnostic for this point, and HG-BACKFILL-MATERIALDNA-KEY-GRAMMAR should be retired/superseded rather than consuming a production edit lane. The retained MaterialDNA counter and dense-validation-budget work are unaffected.
evidence: Current main@ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1 MaterialDNA.luau validateProjectKey contains string.match(value, "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/%-]*$"). The '%' is immediately followed by '-', so the pattern token is '%-' (escaped literal hyphen), not a literal percent member.

Luau documents Lua 5.1 as its baseline language semantics; Lua pattern documentation defines %x for non-alphanumeric x as the standard literal escape and specifically uses '%-' to include a hyphen in a set. Under those semantics, the current set accepts lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_', '/', and '-', matching the validator diagnostic.

Historical finding evt-20260811-081620-mat8c3r1-materialdna-key-grammar and proposed HG-BACKFILL-MATERIALDNA-KEY-GRAMMAR both interpreted the '%' escape introducer as an admitted character and should not be used as proof of a product defect.

Existing shipped fixture keys and the retained #353 repair-count patch do not rely on a percent grammar change. Proposed HG-BACKFILL-MATERIALDNA-DENSE-BOUNDS remains independently supported by direct source evidence and is not superseded by this correction.

No Luau/Lune execution, Roblox Studio, viewport, physical-contact, timing, or two-client evidence is claimed; this is a source-semantics/capacity-mining correction intended to prevent duplicate or harmful WIP.
